title: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
title_zh: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are extended with agent skills, directories whose SKILL.md tells the model when and how to perform a task. Because skills come from independent sources, such as teams, individual developers, plugins, and copied collections, an installed skill can end up co-installed with a similar skill that does the same job, and the model chooses between them from names and descriptions alone. In a conflict, the installed skill loses its core functions, such as a ban on touching git, because the similar skill runs in its place or changes what it does. The task still counts as completed, so existing benchmarks, which check only whether the task passes, miss such cases. We present the first empirical study of such conflicts. From snapshots of 20,947 repositories, we mine 822,109 candidate pairs of similar skills, have a large language model judge a stratified sample of 3,754, and run 312 of the confirmed pairs on three models, in 6,368 runs with 169,294 tool calls over 542 hours of agent time. We report five findings. (1) Skills that can conflict are common, with nearly one in four installed skills co-installed with one that does the same job, and 37% of the judged skills inside copied collections. (2) Most pairs that can conflict involve normative skills, followed by capability skills. (3) Without lowering task completion, a similar skill takes one in five runs away from the installed skill, and runs that open the similar skill first lose more than a third of the exclusive core functions that the installed skill fulfills alone. (4) Where a skill is installed decides which one runs, listing order barely matters, and the final reply names the skill used in only 0.9% of substituted runs. (5) A conflict is decided at the first read of a skill, almost always before the agent changes any file, and a pre-tool hook at that read brings fidelity on exclusive core functions back to the level of runs that open the installed skill first. Benchmarks should therefore score exclusive core functions, and platforms should guard the first read and show which skill ran.

paragraphs.en: Coding agents such as Claude Code are increasingly extended with agent skills . A skill is a directory with a SKILL.md file whose name and description tell the model when to use it, followed by instructions and optional scripts ( Anthropic, 2026a ; Agent Skills, 2026b ) . Developers write skills to encode what a capable model would not do on its own, such as the pull-request format of a team, a release checklist, or a safety rule. Skills are now shared at scale. Recent studies collect 138,133 SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and 42,447 skills from two marketplaces ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . Skills are thus a new kind of software component. Like libraries or plugins, they are packaged, shared through marketplaces, and co-installed ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , but they are written in natural language and executed by a model ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 像 Claude Code 这样的编码智能体正越来越多地通过智能体技能得到扩展。 一项技能是一个包含 SKILL.md 文件的目录，其名称和描述会告诉模型何时使用它，后面跟着说明和可选的脚本（Anthropic, 2026a；Agent Skills, 2026b）。 开发者编写技能来编码一个能力强大的模型自身不会执行的操作，例如团队的拉取请求格式、发布检查清单或安全规则。 如今，技能可以大规模共享。 最近的研究从 20,556 个仓库中收集了 138,133 份 SKILL.md 文件（Zhang et al., 2026），并从两个市场平台中收集了 42,447 项技能（Liu et al., 2026b）。 因此，技能是一种新型的软件组件。 与库或插件一样，它们可以被打包、通过市场平台共享并协同安装（Anthropic, 2025），但它们的编写语言是自然语言，并由模型执行（Liang et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Because skills come from many sources, two skills that do the same job can end up co-installed without anyone choosing the pair. A team commits project skills to its repository, which everyone who works there receives, whereas each developer keeps personal skills under the home directory, which load in all of their projects ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , and can install plugins that add their skills to every project ( Anthropic, 2026b ) . Skills also arrive in bulk, because a plugin can bring several skills and projects copy whole skill collections. Such pairs are common. Reconstructing the skills that Claude Code would load in 20,947 public repositories, we estimate that nearly one in four installed skills, about 10,100 when near-duplicates are counted once, is already co-installed with a skill that does the same job (§ 4.1 ). In one project, for example, anthropics-skills--docx and openai-skills--doc both handle Word documents, and another co-installs qa-patrol with its variant qa-patrol-team . Copied collections bring many such pairs. In the 489 projects that copy a whole collection, 37% of the judged skills already have a skill that does the same job in the same project, against 19% in other projects. These estimates are conservative, because public repositories rarely show the personal skills and plugins that developers add. Nearly two in three installed skills, about 26,100, have such a skill by another author that a user could add. In a public issue report, a developer asked for the self-improvement skill of a project, but a personal fork of the same name ran instead and targeted an unrelated repository, which the developer noticed only after reading the output ( seasonedcc/seasoned-skills, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由于技能来自多种来源，两个执行相同功能的技能可能会在没有任何人主动选择的情况下被同时安装。 团队会将项目技能提交到其仓库中，所有参与该项目的人都会收到这些技能；而每位开发者则会将个人技能保留在本地主目录下，这些技能会在他们所有的项目中加载（Anthropic, 2026a），并且可以安装插件，将他们的技能添加到每个项目中（Anthropic, 2026b）。 技能也会批量出现，因为一个插件可能包含多个技能，而项目则会完整复制整个技能集。这类成对出现的技能很常见。 通过重建 Claude Code 会在 20,947 个公开仓库中加载的技能，我们估计，已安装技能中近四分之一（若将近似重复项计为一次，则约为 10,100 个）已经与执行相同功能的另一个技能被同时安装（§ 4.1）。 例如，在一个项目中，anthropics-skills--docx 和 openai-skills--doc 都能处理 Word 文档；另一个项目则同时安装了 qa-patrol 及其变体 qa-patrol-team。 被复制的技能集带来了许多这样的成对技能。 在完整复制整个技能集的 489 个项目中，经评估的 37% 的技能已有另一个执行相同功能的技能存在于同一项目中，而在其他项目中这一比例为 19%。 这些估计值较为保守，因为公开仓库很少显示开发者添加的个人技能和插件。 已安装技能中近三分之二（约 26,100 个）拥有由其他作者发布的同类技能，用户也可以添加这些技能。 在一份公开的 issue 报告中，一位开发者请求获取某个项目的自我提升技能，但实际运行的是同名个人分支，该分支却针对一个无关的仓库；直到阅读输出结果后，这位开发者才注意到这一问题（seasonedcc/seasoned-skills, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: In such a conflict , a similar skill takes the place of the installed skill or changes what it does, and the behaviors that the user installed the skill for are lost. We call these behaviors the core functions of the skill. Skills that do the same job still differ in their core functions. In our experimental pairs, the similar skill does not ask for 73% of the core functions of the installed skill that apply to the task (§ 3.6 ). A conflict is hard to see because the task is often still completed. Most skill benchmarks cannot capture this loss, because they score a run by whether the task passes its tests ( Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Song and Wei, 2026 ) or whether the right skill is retrieved ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . A pass or a fail is particularly coarse for skills, because a skill can change how the work is done without changing whether it passes ( Qin et al., 2026 ) . SWE-Skills-Bench, for example, finds that 39 of 49 skills yield zero pass-rate improvement ( Han et al., 2026b ) , and losing such a skill cannot lower the pass rate either. Because teams use skills to encode their conventions and safety rules, a conflict can make the agent break them while the task still passes. In one of our runs, a similar skill led the agent to commit work that the installed skill forbids, without saying which skill it used, and the task was still completed (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在这种冲突中，一个类似的智能体会取代已安装的智能体，或改变其执行的功能，而用户安装该智能体时所期望的行为也会随之丢失。 我们将这些行为称为智能体的核心功能。 执行相同任务的智能体，其核心功能仍然存在差异。 在我们的实验对比中，类似的智能体并未调用已安装智能体中与任务相关的 73% 的核心功能（§ 3.6）。 这种冲突很难察觉，因为任务通常仍然能够完成。 大多数智能体基准测试无法捕捉到这种损失，因为它们通过任务是否通过测试（Li et al., 2026; Han et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026c; Song and Wei, 2026）或是否检索到了正确的智能体（Kang et al., 2026; Zheng et al., 2026）来评估运行结果。 对于智能体而言，仅以“通过”或“失败”作为评判标准显得过于粗略，因为智能体可以在不改变任务结果的情况下改变任务的执行方式（Qin et al., 2026）。 例如，SWE-Skills-Bench 发现，在 49 个智能体中，有 39 个的智能体通过率没有任何提升（Han et al., 2026b），而丢失这类智能体也不会导致通过率下降。 由于团队使用智能体来编码其操作惯例和安全规则，冲突可能导致智能体违反这些规则，而任务本身仍然能够通过测试。 在我们的某次运行中，一个类似的智能体导致智能体执行了已安装的智能体所禁止的操作，且未说明使用了哪个智能体，但任务最终仍然完成（图 1）。

sents.en: A conflict is hard to see because the task is often still completed.

sents.en: Most skill benchmarks cannot capture this loss, because they score a run by whether the task passes its tests ( Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Song and Wei, 2026 ) or whether the right skill is retrieved ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 大多数智能体基准测试无法捕捉到这种损失，因为它们通过任务是否通过测试（Li et al., 2026; Han et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026c; Song and Wei, 2026）或是否检索到了正确的智能体（Kang et al., 2026; Zheng et al., 2026）来评估运行结果。

sents.en: A pass or a fail is particularly coarse for skills, because a skill can change how the work is done without changing whether it passes ( Qin et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: SWE-Skills-Bench, for example, finds that 39 of 49 skills yield zero pass-rate improvement ( Han et al., 2026b ) , and losing such a skill cannot lower the pass rate either.
sents.zh: 例如，SWE-Skills-Bench 发现，在 49 个智能体中，有 39 个的智能体通过率没有任何提升（Han et al., 2026b），而丢失这类智能体也不会导致通过率下降。

sents.en: Because teams use skills to encode their conventions and safety rules, a conflict can make the agent break them while the task still passes.

sents.en: In one of our runs, a similar skill led the agent to commit work that the installed skill forbids, without saying which skill it used, and the task was still completed (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 在我们的某次运行中，一个类似的智能体导致智能体执行了已安装的智能体所禁止的操作，且未说明使用了哪个智能体，但任务最终仍然完成（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Whether co-installed software components work together is a long-standing question in software engineering, studied for packages that cannot be co-installed ( Vouillon and Di Cosmo, 2013 ; Artho et al., 2012 ) , conflicting dependencies ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , and clashing module names ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) . For skills, the question is largely open. Prior work has shown that adding skills can hurt a coding agent, but it has measured the harm through task completion. Song and Wei (2026) find that expanding a library of helpful skills to 202 skills lowers the pass rate by 21 percentage points on average, mostly because the model selects a wrong skill or none, and Liu et al. (2026c) show that agents often fail to load the skills a task needs once they must select them. Studies of tool selection find strong position and description biases when several tools can serve a request ( Blankenstein et al., 2026 ; Faghih et al., 2025 ) , but they report which tool is chosen rather than what the user loses. Large-scale studies that collect skills from marketplaces and GitHub examine their security and reusability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has systematically studied what such a conflict does to the core functions of the installed skill, how the platform and the model resolve the conflict, whether the user is told, or at what point a conflict is decided and whether it can be stopped there.
paragraphs.zh: 共同安装的软件组件能否协同工作是软件工程领域一个长期存在的问题，相关研究已针对无法共同安装的软件包（Vouillon 和 Di Cosmo，2013；Artho 等，2012）、存在冲突的依赖关系（Wang 等，2020）以及模块名称冲突（Zhu 等，2024）展开。 对于技能而言，这一问题在很大程度上仍悬而未决。 先前的研究已表明，添加技能可能会损害编码智能体的表现，但这些研究是通过任务完成度来衡量其负面影响的。 Song 和 Wei（2026）发现，将实用技能库从原有规模扩展至 202 项技能后，任务通过率平均下降了 21 个百分点，这主要是因为模型选择了错误的技能或未选择任何技能；而 Liu 等 （2026c）则指出，当智能体必须主动选择技能时，它们常常无法加载任务所需的技能。 关于工具选择的研究发现，当多种工具均可满足请求时，模型会表现出强烈的位置偏好和描述偏见（Blankenstein 等，2026；Faghih 等，2025），但这些研究仅报告了所选工具，而非用户因此遭受的损失。 从市场平台和 GitHub 收集技能的大规模研究，对其安全性和可重用性进行了考察（Liu 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026）。 据我们所知，目前尚无研究系统性地探讨此类冲突对已安装技能核心功能的具体影响、平台与模型如何化解冲突、用户是否被明确告知，以及冲突在哪个阶段被判定并能否在此终止。

paragraphs.en: Dependency conflicts between packages are usually declared or resolved by rules, such as version constraints, that a tool can check from package metadata before anything runs ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Vouillon and Di Cosmo, 2013 ) . A conflict between skills is usually resolved by the model during the run instead, which makes these questions hard to answer in three ways. ❶ A conflict hides behind success. Two skills compete because they do the same job, and for the same reason either one can complete the task, so the likelier a conflict, the less it shows. Its only trace is missing behavior specific to the installed skill, which is written in prose, mixed with examples and generic advice, and different for every skill. ❷ A conflict is resolved out of sight. Unless a personal skill overrides a project skill of the same name, the model chooses from a few hundred characters of description, without having to tell the user. It sometimes reads the files of a skill instead of invoking it, and its choice can change from one run to the next. What it sees depends on listing order, scope, and the model, which change together in practice. ❸ A conflict is decided at run time, yet it must be caught before the similar skill does the work. The model chooses from the user’s request and a few hundred characters per skill, so whether two skills conflict may depend on a request that does not exist when they are installed, and similar wording does not imply the same job. Learning which pairs are risky requires the pairs that users actually combine, yet the personal skills and plugins that a user installs are rarely visible in public.
paragraphs.zh: 包之间的依赖冲突通常通过规则（例如版本约束）来声明或解决，工具可以在任何操作运行之前根据包的元数据进行检查（Wang 等人，2020；Vouillon 和 Di Cosmo，2013）。 技能之间的冲突通常由模型在运行过程中解决，这使得这些问题难以从三个方面回答。❶ 冲突隐藏在成功背后。 两种技能之所以相互竞争，是因为它们执行相同的工作，并且出于同样的原因，任何一种都可以完成任务；因此，冲突越可能发生，它就越不明显。 其唯一的痕迹是缺少已安装技能特有的行为，这些行为以散文形式描述，并与示例和通用建议混合在一起，且每种技能的情况都不同。❷ 冲突在幕后被解决。 除非个人技能覆盖了同名的项目技能，否则模型会从数百个字符的描述中选择，而无需告知用户。 有时模型会读取技能的文件而不是调用它，并且其选择在一次运行到下一次运行之间可能会发生变化。 模型看到的内容取决于列表顺序、作用域和模型本身，而这些在实践中会同时变化。❸ 冲突在运行时决定，但必须在相似的技能执行任务之前被捕获。 模型从用户的请求和每种技能提供的数百个字符中进行选择，因此两种技能是否存在冲突可能取决于安装时并不存在的请求，而类似的措辞并不意味着它们执行的是相同的工作。 要学习哪些技能组合存在风险，需要依赖用户实际组合使用的技能对，但用户安装的个性化技能和插件很少在公开信息中可见。

paragraphs.en: To tackle these challenges, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Claude Code on pairs of an installed skill A A and a similar skill B B . For ❶, we derive checks for each skill from its text alone. These checks are its core functions, the requirements that a competent model would not meet without the skill, quoted from its text, and checkable in the output. The first three that apply to a task, in rank order, are fixed before any run, and the share of them fulfilled in a run is the fidelity , which we report next to task completion. To isolate what only A A provides, we also label each core function of A A as exclusive when B B does not ask for it (§ 3.6 , § 3.7 ). For ❷, we observe the choice in the full record of tool calls, including reads of skill files. This record separates substitution , in which B B is used instead of A A , from interference , in which A A is used but the result still changes. We then change one factor at a time, running each pair with only A A , only B B , A A and B B , and A A with an unrelated skill, then with the listing order reversed and with B B moved to the personal or the plugin scope, on three models (5,166 runs). Paired comparisons over hundreds of pairs separate real differences from run-to-run variation (§ 3.8 , § 3.9 ). For ❸, we reconstruct from complete snapshots the skills that Claude Code would load in 20,947 repositories, pair each installed skill with similar skills in the same installation list and in other projects, and let a large language model (LLM) judge whether two skills do the same job. A stratified sample of 3,754 judged pairs gives prevalence estimates and 312 experimental pairs of normative, capability, and script-bearing skills (§ 3.2 –§ 3.7 ). Because a conflict is decided at run time, we then locate the first read of each skill in the record of tool calls, compare runs of the same pair and model that open different skills first, and test a guard at that read in a new experiment on the 187 pair–model combinations at risk (§ 3.9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们对 Claude Code 进行了一项受控的经验性研究，研究对象是已安装的技能 A A 与相似技能 B B 的组合。 针对 ❶，我们仅根据每种技能的文本内容推导出相应的检查项。 这些检查项即其核心功能，也是具备能力的模型在没有该技能时无法满足的要求；它们均引自技能文本，并可通过输出结果进行验证。 适用于某项任务的前三个检查项（按优先级排序）在每次运行前就已固定，其中在单次运行中满足的检查项比例即为“保真度”，我们将在任务完成结果旁报告该指标。 为隔离仅由 A A 提供的功能，我们将 A A 的每个核心功能标记为“专属功能”，前提是 B B 并未要求该功能（§ 3.6、§ 3.7）。 针对 ❷，我们观察完整工具调用记录中的选择情况，包括对技能文件的读取操作。 该记录区分了两种情况：替代（即使用 B B 而非 A A）与干扰（即使用了 A A，但结果仍发生变化）。 随后，我们每次仅改变一个因素，分别运行仅含 A A、仅含 B B、同时包含 A A 和 B B 的组合，以及 A A 搭配无关技能的组合；接着重复上述过程，但反转技能列表顺序，并将 B B 移至个人作用域或插件作用域，在三种模型上共执行 5,166 次运行。 通过对数百组配对进行比较，我们能够区分真正的差异与单次运行间的随机波动（§ 3.8、§ 3.9）。 针对 ❸，我们从完整快照中重建 Claude Code 会在 20,947 个仓库中加载的技能，将每个已安装技能与其在同一安装列表中或与其他项目中的相似技能配对，并让大型语言模型（LLM）判断两种技能是否执行相同任务。 通过对 3,754 组配对进行分层抽样，我们获得了其普遍性估计值，以及包含规范性、能力性和脚本型技能的 312 组实验性配对（§ 3.2–§ 3.7）。 由于冲突是在运行时决定的，我们接着在工具调用记录中定位每种技能的首次读取位置，比较同一配对与模型在不同技能被优先加载时的运行结果，并在新的实验中测试该读取位置的防护机制，覆盖存在风险的 187 种配对–模型组合（§ 3.9）。

sents.en: Because a conflict is decided at run time, we then locate the first read of each skill in the record of tool calls, compare runs of the same pair and model that open different skills first, and test a guard at that read in a new experiment on the 187 pair–model combinations at risk (§ 3.9 ).

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Impact). When two similar skills are co-installed, do task completion and the core functions of the installed skill decline? We also ask whether a decline comes from substitution or from interference, and how it differs across normative, capability, and script-bearing pairs.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（影响）。 当两个相似的技能被同时安装时，任务完成度和已安装技能的核心功能会下降吗？ 我们还想知道，这种下降是源于替代还是干扰，以及它在规范性、能力性和带脚本的技能对之间有何差异。

paragraphs.en: Our study makes the following major findings. A similar skill takes one in five runs away from the installed skill, yet task completion does not drop. The use of the installed skill falls by 19.9 percentage points, against 5.9 points with an unrelated skill, so a benchmark that checks only task completion would call co-installation harmless. Its fidelity falls by 2.6 points, or 5.6 points on its exclusive core functions, and most of the loss comes from runs that do not use it. Where a skill is installed decides which one runs, and the final reply rarely says so. A personal skill of the same name overrides the installed skill in every listing, yet models still read the overridden files in 29.2% of runs. A plugin skill is used in only 2.9% of runs, and reversing the listing order, which biases tool selection, changes the use of the installed skill by only + 0.6 +0.6 points. When the similar skill replaces the installed one, the final reply names it in 0.9% of runs. A conflict is decided at the first read of a skill, almost always before the agent changes anything, and a guard at that read keeps the core functions of the installed skill. Within the same pair and model, opening the similar skill first lowers fidelity on the exclusive core functions of the installed skill by 9.4 points. In 97% of the runs that open the similar skill first, the agent has not yet changed any file. In a new experiment, a pre-tool hook that denies the first read of the similar skill made the model switch to the installed skill in 96% of cases and brought this fidelity back to the level of runs that open the installed skill first, with a significant gain for every model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究得出以下主要发现。 在五分之一的运行中，类似技能会取代已安装的技能，但任务完成率并未下降。 已安装技能的使用率下降了 19.9 个百分点，而无关技能仅导致 5.9 个百分点的下降，因此仅检查任务完成率的基准测试会认为同时安装无害。 其保真度下降了 2.6 点，在专属核心功能上则下降了 5.6 点，且大部分损失来自未使用该技能的运行。 哪个技能被安装决定了哪个技能会被运行，而最终回复中很少提及这一点。 同名的个人技能在所有列表中都会覆盖已安装的技能，但模型在 29.2% 的运行中仍会读取被覆盖的文件。 插件技能仅在 2.9% 的运行中被使用，而反转列表顺序（这会影响工具选择）仅使已安装技能的使用率增加了 +0.6 点。 当类似技能取代已安装的技能时，最终回复在 0.9% 的运行中提到了该技能。 冲突在首次读取技能时即被决定，几乎总是在智能体做出任何更改之前，而在此读取阶段设置的防护机制保留了已安装技能的专属核心功能。 在同一对技能和模型中，先打开类似技能会使已安装技能的专属核心功能的保真度下降 9.4 点。 在 97% 的先打开类似技能的运行中，智能体尚未更改任何文件。 在一项新实验中，一个阻止类似技能首次读取的预工具钩子使模型在 96% 的情况下切换到了已安装的技能，并将保真度恢复到了先打开已安装技能的运行水平，所有模型都获得了显著提升。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code selects skills in two stages ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . First, it places a listing of skill names and descriptions into the context of the model, truncating the combined description and when_to_use text of each skill at 1,536 characters. Second, the model invokes a skill when the user’s request matches its description, and only then is the body loaded. The choice of the model between two similar skills therefore rests on a few hundred characters of text per skill, and the body, where the requirements of the skill usually live, is read only after the choice is made.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 分两个阶段选择技能（Anthropic，2026a）。 首先，它将技能名称和描述列表放入模型上下文，并将每个技能的合并描述和“何时使用”文本截断至 1,536 个字符。 其次，当用户请求与某个技能的描述匹配时，模型才会调用该技能，此时才加载其主体内容。 因此，模型在两个相似技能之间的选择仅基于每个技能数百个字符的文本，而通常包含技能要求的主体内容则是在做出选择之后才被读取。

paragraphs.en: Skills can be installed at several scopes, summarized for Claude Code in Table 1 , and plugins can be enabled for a user or for a whole repository ( Anthropic, 2026b ) . When two skills have the same name, the scope decides whether one overrides the other or both are listed ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . We use Claude Code as the example, but Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot also load project skills and personal skills ( OpenAI, 2026a ; Google, 2026 ; GitHub, 2026a ) . Gemini CLI and the Copilot CLI prefer the project skill ( Google, 2026 ; GitHub, 2026b ) , Claude Code prefers the personal skill, and Codex lists both ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , although the implementation guide of the format calls the project-first rule the universal convention ( Agent Skills, 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: The installed skill A A is a skill that a project or user installed for a purpose. A similar skill B B is another skill that does the same job. The two are co-installed when they are visible in the same session. The core functions of a skill are the requirements that a competent model would not meet without it, that are quoted from its text, and that can be checked in the output of a given task (§ 3.6 ). The primary core functions of A A are the first three that apply to a task, and the fidelity of a run is the share of them fulfilled.
paragraphs.zh: 已安装的智能体技能 A A 是一种项目或用户出于特定目的而安装的智能体技能。 类似的智能体技能 B B 是另一种执行相同功能的智能体技能。 当这两种智能体技能在同一会话中可见时，它们会被一同安装。 智能体技能的核心功能是指，若无该技能，一个能力合格模型便无法满足的需求；这些需求会从其文本中引用，并可通过给定任务的输出结果进行验证（§ 3.6）。 A A 的主要核心功能是适用于某项任务的前三项功能，而运行保真度则是其中被满足的功能所占的比例。

sents.zh: 已安装的智能体技能 A A 是一种项目或用户出于特定目的而安装的智能体技能。

sents.en: A similar skill B B is another skill that does the same job.
sents.zh: 类似的智能体技能 B B 是另一种执行相同功能的智能体技能。

sents.en: The two are co-installed when they are visible in the same session.
sents.zh: 当这两种智能体技能在同一会话中可见时，它们会被一同安装。

sents.en: The core functions of a skill are the requirements that a competent model would not meet without it, that are quoted from its text, and that can be checked in the output of a given task (§ 3.6 ).
sents.zh: 智能体技能的核心功能是指，若无该技能，一个能力合格模型便无法满足的需求；这些需求会从其文本中引用，并可通过给定任务的输出结果进行验证（§ 3.6）。

sents.en: The primary core functions of A A are the first three that apply to a task, and the fidelity of a run is the share of them fulfilled.
sents.zh: A A 的主要核心功能是适用于某项任务的前三项功能，而运行保真度则是其中被满足的功能所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Two skills conflict when co-installing them changes what the user gets from A A , in task completion or in fidelity, compared with installing A A alone. A conflict can arise in two ways. In substitution , A A is not used because the platform or the model uses B B instead. In interference , A A is used, yet the result still changes, for example because instructions or scripts of B B change what it does. A run may also use neither skill, which we report as a third outcome. Throughout, we take the view of a user who expects the behavior of A A , and each request asks for its job. Whatever the mechanism, the model may disclose to the user that two similar skills were available or which one it used.
paragraphs.zh: 当两个技能同时安装时，如果它们改变了用户从 A A 获得的结果（无论是任务完成度还是保真度），那么这两个技能就会发生冲突；而单独安装 A A 则不会出现这种情况。 冲突可能以两种方式产生。 在替代情况下，由于平台或模型改用 B B，因此不会使用 A A。 在干扰情况下，虽然使用了 A A，但结果仍然发生了变化，例如因为 B B 的指令或脚本改变了其执行的操作。 一次运行也可能不使用这两种技能中的任何一种，我们将这种情况报告为第三种结果。 在整个过程中，我们都站在用户的角度进行思考：用户期望 A A 按照特定方式运行，并且每次请求都是要求它完成相应的任务。 无论具体机制如何，模型都可以向用户说明有两种相似的技能可供选择，或者告知用户最终使用了哪一种。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows a clear case from our study. The project skill checkpoint forbids any change to the git state, and with only this skill installed, the model saves a handoff note without committing. With a similar skill of the same name added to the project as checkpoint-2 , the model uses the similar skill instead, commits the work, and names no skill in its reply. Both runs complete the task, so a check of task completion passes both, whereas the core function of the project skill fails in the second (challenge ❶).

paragraphs.en: The measure that can reveal a loss depends on what a skill contributes, so we distinguish three types of skills.
paragraphs.zh: 能够揭示损失的指标取决于技能所做出的贡献，因此我们将技能分为三种类型。

paragraphs.en: Normative skills encode conventions, such as pull-request and commit-message formats or a coding style, which the documentation calls reference content ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . A capable model often completes a task without any skill ( Han et al., 2026b ) , so losing a normative skill leaves task completion unchanged and shows only in fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 规范性技能编码了各种惯例，例如拉取请求和提交消息的格式或某种编码风格，文档将这些内容称为参考内容（Anthropic, 2026a）。 一个能力强的模型通常无需任何技能就能完成任务（Han et al., 2026b），因此失去一项规范性技能并不会改变任务完成的结果，而只会影响结果的保真度。

paragraphs.en: Capability skills supply specific knowledge or tools without which the task is done poorly, as in SkillsBench, where curated skills raise the average pass rate from 33.9% to 50.5% ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Substituting such a skill can lower task completion as well as fidelity.

paragraphs.en: Script-bearing skills ship executable scripts that their instructions run. When such a skill is substituted, its scripts do not run at all, and when both skills are active, the scripts of one skill may run under the instructions of the other. We therefore treat pairs whose installed skill bundles scripts as a type of their own.

paragraphs.en: We designed the study to answer the three RQs with pairs that are or could plausibly be co-installed and a loss measure fixed in advance (Figure 2 ). We study Claude Code because Anthropic introduced skills for it before opening the format as a standard ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , it is the largest identifiable target of public skills ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Galster et al., 2026 ) , and its documentation states how skills are loaded and overridden ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . Because the full design costs about $5,550 at API prices on one platform (§ 3.8 ), we run it on Claude Code only and check its main effects on Codex. There, with gpt-5.5 , gpt-5.6-luna , and gpt-5.6-sol on 193 pairs judged in the same way, the similar skill lowered the use of A A by 18.2 percentage points and fidelity on its first three exclusive core functions by 3.4, close to the 20.1 and 4.6 points on Claude Code for the same pairs, without lowering task completion. The study reconstructs installations (§ 3.2 – 3.3 ), mines pairs (§ 3.4 – 3.5 ), builds cases around the core functions of the installed skill (§ 3.6 – 3.7 ), and scores controlled runs (§ 3.8 – 3.9 ). Sampling and rating follow published guidelines ( Baltes and Ralph, 2022 ; Ralph et al., 2021 ) , and two human raters check every LLM-assisted step on random samples (§ 3.10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计这项研究，旨在通过成对测试（这些智能体已经或可能合理地共同安装）以及预先固定的损失度量标准，来回答三个研究问题（图2）。 我们选择研究 Claude Code，因为 Anthropic 在将其格式标准化之前已为其引入了技能（Anthropic, 2025），它是可识别的公共技能中规模最大的目标（Zhang et al., 2026; Galster et al., 2026），且其文档说明了技能的加载和覆盖方式（Anthropic, 2026a）。 由于完整的设计方案在单一平台上的 API 费用约为 5,550 美元（§3.8），因此我们仅在 Claude Code 上运行该方案，并检验其对 Codex 的主要影响。 在该平台上，使用 gpt-5.5、gpt-5.6-luna 和 gpt-5.6-sol 对 193 对以相同方式评估的智能体进行测试发现，类似的技能使 A A 的使用率降低了 18.2 个百分点，并将其前三个专属核心功能的保真度降低了 3.4 个百分点；这一结果与 Claude Code 在相同智能体对上的 20.1 和 4.6 个百分点接近，且未降低任务完成率。 该研究重建了安装过程（§3.2–3.3），挖掘了智能体对（§3.4–3.5），围绕已安装技能的核心功能构建了测试用例（§3.6–3.7），并对受控运行进行了评分（§3.8–3.9）。 采样和评分遵循已发表的指南（Baltes and Ralph, 2022; Ralph et al., 2021），两名人类评分员会对随机样本中的每一步 LLM 辅助操作进行检查（§3.10）。

paragraphs.en: Learning which pairs are risky requires the pairs that users actually combine (challenge ❸), so we first reconstruct which skills are co-installed. We start from a corpus of public SKILL.md files collected on 18 July 2026, with 55,698 distinct skills and 105,302 non-fork copies in 20,947 repositories. The corpus was built mainly with GitHub code search, which indexes only default branches ( GitHub, 2026c ) and returns at most 1,000 results per query ( GitHub, 2026c ) . To recover every skill, we therefore fetch the complete file tree of each repository at the last commit no later than its recorded push time, and we store the commit hash and the git object id of every file. This pins the data, which repositories can otherwise rewrite or delete ( González-Barahona and Robles, 2012 ; Kalliamvakou et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 要识别哪些组合存在风险，需要依赖用户实际组合使用的技能对（挑战 ❸），因此我们首先重建了哪些技能是共同安装的。 我们从 2026 年 7 月 18 日收集的公共 SKILL.md 文件语料库入手，其中包含 55,698 个独特技能和 20,947 个仓库中的 105,302 份非分叉副本。 该语料库主要通过 GitHub 代码搜索构建而成，该搜索仅索引默认分支（GitHub, 2026c），且每次查询最多返回 1,000 条结果（GitHub, 2026c）。 因此，为了恢复所有技能，我们获取了每个仓库在最后一个提交时的完整文件树，该提交时间不晚于其记录的上推时间，并存储了每个文件的提交哈希和 Git 对象 ID。 此举锁定了数据，否则这些仓库可能会重写或删除这些数据（González-Barahona and Robles, 2012；Kalliamvakou et al., 2016）。

paragraphs.en: A skill counts as installed when Claude Code would load it in a session (Table 1 ) ( Anthropic, 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026d ) . This covers skills in a project or nested .claude/skills directory of a real project, including resolved symbolic links, and skills in the personal directory kept in a dotfiles repository ( Zhu and Godfrey, 2025 ) . It also covers plugins placed under .claude/skills or enabled in the committed settings of the project, the two ways to share a plugin through a repository, but not other plugins ( Anthropic, 2026d ) . We exclude deeper nesting, which a maintainer states is unsupported ( anthropics/claude-code, 2026 ) , the directories of other agents, documentation, example, and test paths ( Herbold et al., 2022 ) , and vendored paths ( GitHub Linguist, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 当 Claude Code 在会话中能够加载某项技能时，该技能即被视为已安装（表 1）（Anthropic, 2026a；Anthropic, 2026d）。 这涵盖了项目中或真实项目嵌套的 .claude/skills 目录中的技能，包括已解析的象征性链接，以及存储在 dotfiles 仓库中的个人目录里的技能（Zhu and Godfrey, 2025）。 这也涵盖了放置在 .claude/skills 下的插件，或在项目已提交的设置中启用的插件——这两种是通过仓库共享插件的方式，但不包括其他插件（Anthropic, 2026d）。 我们排除更深层的嵌套结构（维护者指出这不受支持）（anthropics/claude-code, 2026），其他智能体的目录、文档、示例和测试路径（Herbold et al., 2022），以及第三方引入的路径（GitHub Linguist, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: An installation list is the set of installed skills that a session in one project or dotfiles repository sees. We obtain 5,106 installation lists, 4,342 of them with at least two distinct skills (Figure 2 ). The A pool holds the 63,104 distinct skills installed in real projects or dotfiles repositories, more than the corpus holds, because the snapshots include skills that code search missed. The B pool holds the 172,750 skills installed in another real project or listed in a plugin marketplace, which a user could plausibly add from elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 安装列表是指某个项目或 dotfiles 仓库中的会话所看到的已安装技能的集合。 我们获得了 5,106 个安装列表，其中 4,342 个至少包含两种不同的技能（图 2）。 A 池包含了在真实项目或 dotfiles 仓库中安装的 63,104 种不同技能，这一数量超过了语料库中的技能总数，因为这些快照还包括了代码搜索未能发现的技能。 B 池包含了在另一个真实项目中安装或在插件市场中列出的 172,750 种技能，这些技能用户完全有可能从其他来源添加进来。

paragraphs.en: To keep only skills that the model can actually use, we downloaded by git object id the 219,817 distinct SKILL.md files in the project, personal, and plugin skill directories of the snapshots. A skill is kept only if Claude Code reads its frontmatter and the model can invoke it, which requires frontmatter on the first line ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , valid YAML ( Agent Skills, 2026b ) , and no disable-model-invocation flag ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . As in prior skill corpora, it must also have a non-empty name and description ( Liu et al., 2026c ) and at least ten lines of instructions ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . These checks keep 207,863 files (94.6%). Versions of one skill count as one skill, so we group near-duplicates ( Lopes et al., 2017 ) into families with MinHash over word 5-grams at a Jaccard threshold of 0.8 ( Broder, 1997 ; Lee et al., 2022 ) , never pair two skills of one family, and use one installed skill per family (43,986 families in the A pool).
paragraphs.zh: 为了仅保留模型实际能够使用的技能，我们通过 Git 对象 ID 下载了快照中项目、个人和插件技能目录下的 219,817 个不同的 SKILL.md 文件。 只有当 Claude Code 读取了技能的元数据且模型能够调用该技能时，才会保留该技能；这要求第一行包含元数据（Anthropic, 2026a）、有效的 YAML 格式（Agent Skills, 2026b），并且没有禁用模型调用的标志（Anthropic, 2026a）。 与先前的技能语料库一样，该技能还必须具有非空的名字和描述（Liu et al., 2026c），以及至少十行说明文字（Liu et al., 2026b）。 经过这些检查后，共保留了 207,863 个文件（占 94.6%）。 同一技能的多个版本仅计为一个技能，因此我们将近重复项（Lopes et al., 2017）通过基于词 5-gram 的 MinHash 方法，在 Jaccard 阈值设为 0.8 的情况下聚类为家族（Broder, 1997; Lee et al., 2022），同一家族内的两个技能绝不会成对出现，并且每个家族仅使用一个已安装的技能（A 池中共有 43,986 个家族）。

paragraphs.en: We pair skills in two ways because each captures a different way in which two skills become co-installed. Within-project pairing combines two skills in the same installation list, so it shows co-installation that actually exists. Cross-project pairing combines an installed skill A A with a skill B B from the B pool by a different author, which models a user who adds a skill from elsewhere, including the personal and plugin scopes that repository scans cannot observe.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以两种方式对技能进行配对，因为每种方式都捕捉了两种技能共同安装的不同情形。 项目内配对将同一安装列表中的两种技能组合在一起，因此能够展示实际存在的共同安装情况。 跨项目配对通过另一位作者，将已安装的技能 A 与来自 B 池的技能 B 组合起来，这模拟了用户从其他来源添加技能的情形，包括个人和插件作用域等仓库扫描无法观察到的范围。

paragraphs.en: To find candidates cheaply, we retrieve them by the text the model sees when choosing, namely the name and the combined description and when_to_use text (§ 2.1 ). We embed this text with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and call the cosine similarity of two embeddings their description similarity . For each installed skill, we keep the ten candidates with the highest description similarity, in the B pool or in the same installation list, excluding the same family and, for cross-project pairing, the same author or repository, as in retrieve-then-confirm pipelines for overlapping tools and skills ( Blankenstein et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Kang et al., 2026 ) . This yields 439,860 cross-project and 382,249 within-project candidate pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了低成本地找到候选项，我们通过模型在选择时看到的文本（即名称以及合并后的描述和 when_to_use 文本）来检索它们（§ 2.1）。 我们使用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（Zhang et al., 2025）对这段文本进行嵌入，并将两个嵌入向量的余弦相似度称为它们的描述相似度。 对于每个已安装的技能，我们保留描述相似度最高的十个候选项，这些候选项位于 B 池中或同一安装列表中，但排除同一系列技能；对于跨项目配对，还排除同一作者或仓库，这与重叠工具和技能的“检索-确认”流程中的做法一致（Blankenstein et al., 2026; Liu et al., 2026a; Kang et al., 2026）。 由此得到了 439,860 对跨项目候选项和 382,249 对项目内候选项。

paragraphs.en: GPT-6 Astra, as the pair judge , then decides whether two skills do the same job. It answers whether, from names and descriptions alone, a request meant for A A could be routed to B B , and whether, after reading their bodies, the two do the same job, are near-duplicates, are related but different, or are unrelated. A pair is confirmed when the second answer is “same job” or “near-duplicate”, and near-duplicates here are skills of different families (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: GPT-6 Astra 作为成对评判者，随后判断两项技能是否执行相同任务。 它会根据名称和描述单独判断：原本指向 A A 的请求是否可以转交给 B B；以及阅读它们的主体内容后，这两项技能是否执行相同任务、是否为近似重复项、是否相关但不同，或者是否无关。 当第二个答案为“相同任务”或“近似重复项”时，该成对即被确认；此处的近似重复项指来自不同类别的技能（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Before sampling, we calibrated a floor on description similarity with 615 pairs, each judged in both orders because LLM judges are sensitive to position ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Following the recall target used to evaluate screening for systematic reviews ( Cohen et al., 2006 ; O’Mara-Eves et al., 2015 ) , we take the highest floor that keeps at least 95% of the confirmed pairs. This floor is 0.72 for cross-project pairing (recall 0.96) and 0.52 for within-project pairing. Confirmed pairs occur even at low description similarity, and below 0.9 only 10% to 37% of the cross-project pairs in each band are confirmed, so similar wording does not imply the same job and description similarity cannot stand in for the pair judge (challenge ❸). Each sampling unit is one installed skill per family, paired with its most similar candidate above the floor, which gives frames of 41,055 cross-project and 43,022 within-project units.
paragraphs.zh: 在采样之前，我们使用 615 对描述对校准了描述相似性的最低阈值，其中每对都按两种顺序进行了判断，因为 LLM 判断者对位置敏感（Zheng et al., 2023）。 遵循用于评估系统性综述筛选的召回率目标（Cohen et al., 2006；O’Mara-Eves et al., 2015），我们取能保留至少 95% 已确认描述对的最高最低阈值。 对于跨项目配对，该最低阈值为 0.72（召回率为 0.96）；对于项目内配对，则为 0.52。 即使描述相似性较低时也会出现已确认的描述对，而在低于 0.9 的情况下，每个区间中仅有 10% 至 37% 的跨项目配对被确认，因此相似的措辞并不意味着工作相同，且描述相似性无法替代配对判断者（挑战 ❸）。 每个采样单元是家庭中的每个已安装技能，并与高于最低阈值的其最相似候选项进行配对，由此形成了 41,055 个跨项目单元和 43,022 个项目内单元。

paragraphs.en: We draw one stratified random sample to estimate prevalence and to select the experimental pairs. The strata cross pairing, whether A A bundles scripts, and description-similarity band, and each pairing-by-script group is sized for a 95% confidence level ( Kalliamvakou et al., 2014 ; United Nations Statistics Division, 2008 ) and a ± \pm 3% margin. Drawing units in a seeded random order yields 3,754 pairs, of which the pair judge confirms 1,639 (1,203 of 1,876 cross-project and 436 of 1,878 within-project pairs). Re-judging 200 random pairs reproduces the verdict almost perfectly (Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.93), and two human raters validate the pair judge on 100 random pairs (§ 3.10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们抽取一个分层随机样本，以估计流行率并选择实验配对。 分层交叉配对（无论是 A A 捆绑脚本、描述相似性带，还是每个配对-脚本组）均按 95% 的置信水平（Kalliamvakou 等，2014；联合国统计司，2008）和 ±\pm 3% 的误差范围进行规模设定。 以预设随机顺序抽取单元后得到 3,754 对，其中配对判定器确认了 1,639 对（包括 1,876 对跨项目配对中的 1,203 对和 1,878 对项目内配对中的 436 对）。 对 200 个随机配对进行重新判定后，结果几乎完全一致（Cohen’s κ\kappa 为 0.93），且两名人类评分者对 100 个随机配对进行了验证（§ 3.10）。

paragraphs.en: Because the only trace of a conflict is missing behavior specific to the installed skill (challenge ❶), we extract the core functions of every skill in a confirmed pair before any run. The extractor, GPT-6 Astra, sees one skill at a time, never its partner or any run, and lists the requirements of the skill that pass three tests. A core function is unique , meaning a competent model doing the same kind of task without the skill would usually not meet it, quoted verbatim from the skill, and checkable in written files, pull requests, commit messages, executed commands, or the final reply. Examples, sample outputs, reference tables, and defaults that a tool adds anyway do not count, and each core function states one requirement, as in checklist-based evaluation ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Cook et al., 2024 ) , with prohibitions counted as requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 由于冲突的唯一痕迹是缺失与已安装技能相关的特定行为（挑战❶），因此我们在任何运行之前，都会提取确认配对中每个技能的核心功能。 提取器 GPT-6 Astra 每次只处理一个技能，从不涉及其搭档或任何运行过程，并列出通过三项测试的技能要求。 核心功能是独特的，也就是说，一个具备能力的模型在没有该技能的情况下执行同类任务时通常无法满足该要求；这些功能直接引自技能本身，并且可以通过书面文件、拉取请求、提交信息、执行命令或最终回复进行验证。 工具自动添加的示例、样本输出、参考表和默认设置不计入其中，且每个核心功能仅陈述一个要求，类似于基于检查表的评估方法（Qin et al., 2024; Cook et al., 2024），其中禁止项也被视为要求。

paragraphs.en: For every pair we build one case that all configurations share. GPT-6 Astra drafts a request for the job of A A , a starting repository of at most 15 files, the applicability of each core function of A A , and a check for each applicable core function and for task completion. A check is either a script over the final repository, the executed commands, and the final reply, which returns fulfilled, not fulfilled, or undecidable, or a yes/no question for the output judge, an LLM described in § 3.9 . Task completion is judged on substance, so any competent way of doing the work counts. Every script is also run on the untouched starting repository, and core functions whose script already passes there are flagged for a sensitivity analysis. In the case of Figure 3 , both runs complete the task, so only the three primary core functions reveal that the second run followed B B instead of A A .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每一对，我们都会构建一个所有配置都共享的案例。 GPT-6 Astra 会起草一份请求，用于处理 A A 的任务，其中包含一个最多 15 个文件的初始仓库、A A 每个核心功能的适用性，以及对每个适用核心功能和任务完成情况的检查。 该请求说明了目标和开发者可能会提及的事实，但绝不会提及任何技能名称、其惯例或描述中的短语，且仓库中不包含针对智能体的任何指令。 检查项可以是针对最终仓库、已执行命令和最终回复的脚本，该脚本返回“已完成”“未完成”或“无法判定”的结果；也可以是一个供输出判官（§3.9 中描述的 LLM）回答的是否问题。 任务完成情况以实质内容为准，因此任何能够完成工作的有效方法都算数。 每个脚本也会在未经修改的初始仓库上运行，而那些脚本在此已通过的核心功能会被标记出来，用于进行敏感性分析。 在图 3 的案例中，两次运行都完成了任务，因此只有三个主要核心功能显示出第二次运行遵循的是 B B 而非 A A。

paragraphs.en: Because a conflict is resolved out of sight (challenge ❷), we change one factor at a time. RQ1 compares the only- A A , the only- B B , and the A+B configuration on every pair, with the same request and starting repository (Table 3 ). The only- B B configuration shows what B B delivers on its own, and paired comparisons over hundreds of pairs separate real differences from run-to-run variation. To separate the effect of a similar skill from that of one more skill, the A+C configuration installs an unrelated skill C C instead of B B on all 312 pairs. C C is one of 167 skills of other cases whose description similarity to A A and to B B is at most 0.435, the median over 200,000 random pairs, and which sits on the same side of A A in the listing as B B and has a description of comparable length. RQ2 adds a swapped configuration, which reverses the listing order of the two skills. Because the scope rules in Table 1 apply to skills of the same name, RQ2 also adds two scope configurations for the 81 pairs whose skills have the same name, all from cross-project pairing. In the personal-scope configuration, B B sits in the personal directory and overrides A A , and in the plugin-scope configuration, B B sits in a plugin, the two skills are listed, and the model chooses.
paragraphs.zh: 由于冲突是在看不见的情况下解决的（挑战 ❷），我们一次只改变一个因素。 RQ1 在每一对组合中，比较了仅包含 A 的智能体配置、仅包含 B 的智能体配置以及 A+B 配置，同时使用相同的请求和初始仓库（表 3）。 仅包含 B 的智能体配置展示了 B 单独能提供的效果，而数百对组合的对比则能区分真正的差异与运行间的波动。 为了将相似技能的影响与多一项技能的影响区分开来，A+C 配置在所有 312 对组合中都用不相关的技能 C 替换了 B。 C 是其他案例中的 167 项技能之一，它与 A 和 B 的描述相似度最多为 0.435（这是 20 万随机组合的中位数），并且在列表中位于与 B 相同的一侧，且描述长度相当。 RQ2 增加了一种交换配置，该配置会反转两种技能在列表中的顺序。 由于表 1 中的作用域规则适用于名称相同的技能，RQ2 还为 81 对组合添加了两种作用域配置，这些组合的技能名称均相同，且全部来自跨项目配对。 在个人作用域配置中，B 位于个人目录并覆盖 A；而在插件作用域配置中，B 位于一个插件内，两种技能都会被列出，由模型进行选择。

paragraphs.en: We measured how Claude Code 2.1.283 lists skills to the model. Under it, 95.8% of the listings shown to Opus 5 in the A+B configuration would lose at least one of the two descriptions. paragraphs.en: Each run starts in a fresh container with no host directory mounted and runs Claude Code 2.1.283 non-interactively for at most 80 turns and 25 minutes. All experiments use three Claude models from the Sonnet, Haiku, and Opus tiers ( Anthropic, 2026c ) , claude-sonnet-4-6 (Sonnet 4.6), claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (Haiku 4.5), and claude-opus-5 (Opus 5), with one run per model, configuration, and pair in a seeded random order. Timeouts are scored as they are, and only infrastructure failures are re-run. The container reaches only the model application programming interface (API) and the PyPI and npm registries, and credentials never enter it. In total, we analyze 5,162 of the 5,166 runs of the configurations, 113 of which timed out. With the guard experiment (§ 3.9 ) and the repeated runs below, the study comprises 6,368 runs, 542 hours of agent time, 169,294 tool calls, 6.3 billion input and 110 million output tokens, and about $5,550 at the API prices that Claude Code reports (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行都从一个全新的容器开始，未挂载任何主机目录，并以非交互式方式运行 Claude Code 2.1.283，最多持续 80 轮或 25 分钟。 所有实验均使用来自 Sonnet、Haiku 和 Opus 层级的三种 Claude 模型（Anthropic, 2026c），即 claude-sonnet-4-6（Sonnet 4.6）、claude-haiku-4-5-20251001（Haiku 4.5）和 claude-opus-5（Opus 5），每个模型、配置和组合均按随机种子顺序运行一次。 超时情况按实际发生计算，仅基础设施故障会重新运行。 容器仅能访问模型应用程序编程接口（API）以及 PyPI 和 npm 注册表，且凭证绝不会进入容器内部。 我们总共分析了 5,166 次配置运行中的 5,162 次，其中 113 次因超时而终止。 包括守护实验（§ 3.9）和下文提到的重复运行，本研究共包含 6,368 次运行、542 小时智能体运行时间、169,294 次工具调用、63 亿输入令牌和 1.1 亿输出令牌，以及根据 Claude Code 报告的 API 价格（表 3）计算出的约 5,550 美元费用。

paragraphs.en: Each combination of model, configuration, and pair runs once, a single-sample estimate of pass@1 ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , because three runs give nearly the same results at three times the cost. paragraphs.en: For every run we record the fidelity, task completion, skill use, and, in configurations that co-install A A and B B , disclosure. Skill use means that the model invokes a skill through the Skill tool or reads or runs files in its installation directory, because models often read the files of a skill directly instead of invoking it (challenge ❷), and we record Skill-tool invocations separately. Disclosure means that the final reply says that more than one suitable skill exists, says which one was used, or asks the user to choose. Scripts decide 327 of the 921 primary core functions inside the offline container, and the output judge decides the other 594, any script check that returns undecidable, and all but 11 checks of task completion. The output judge is GPT-6 Astra, which sees the final repository, the full record of tool calls with skill names and paths masked, and the final reply, but neither the configuration nor which skill is A A , because LLM judges are sensitive to cues unrelated to the answer ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . A conditional core function whose condition did not occur counts as not applicable.

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, we compare the A+B configuration with the only- A A configuration and report paired risk differences in fidelity, task completion, and the use of A A , per model and pooled. Each difference is taken within pair and model, the pooled value averages the three models within each pair, and estimates are unweighted averages over the experimental pairs with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) computed over pairs, with tests Holm-corrected over six cells and two outcomes, fidelity and task completion ( Holm, 1979 ) . Following Song and Wei (2026) , we condition on skill use, so a loss in a run that used B B but not A A is substitution, a loss in a run that used A A is interference, and runs that use neither skill form a third group. As control checks, A A alone should mostly fulfill its core functions and B B alone should mostly not, and we report the loss separately on the exclusive and the shared core functions (§ 3.6 ). Sensitivity analyses use the first primary core function only, all applicable core functions, and only the core functions whose script does not pass on the starting repository.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题1（RQ1），我们将A+B配置与仅使用A的智能体配置进行比较，并按模型和合并结果分别报告在保真度、任务完成度和A智能体的使用方面的成对风险差异。 每个差异均基于配对和模型计算；合并值是对每对模型中三个模型的平均值，估计值则是各实验配对的无加权平均值，并计算了95%置信区间（CI），其中检验结果经过Holm校正，涵盖六个单元格和两个结果：保真度与任务完成度（Holm, 1979）。 遵循Song和Wei（2026）的方法，我们以技能使用作为条件：在运行中使用了B智能体但未使用A智能体的损失属于替代效应；仅使用A智能体的损失属于干扰效应；而未使用任何技能的运行则构成第三组。 作为控制检查，单独使用A智能体应主要实现其核心功能，而单独使用B智能体则不应主要实现这些功能；我们将分别报告在专属核心功能和共享核心功能上的损失（§3.6）。 敏感性分析仅使用第一个主要核心功能、所有适用核心功能，以及仅那些脚本在初始仓库中未通过验证的核心功能。

sents.zh: 每个差异均基于配对和模型计算；合并值是对每对模型中三个模型的平均值，估计值则是各实验配对的无加权平均值，并计算了95%置信区间（CI），其中检验结果经过Holm校正，涵盖六个单元格和两个结果：保真度与任务完成度（Holm, 1979）。

sents.en: Following Song and Wei (2026) , we condition on skill use, so a loss in a run that used B B but not A A is substitution, a loss in a run that used A A is interference, and runs that use neither skill form a third group.
sents.zh: 遵循Song和Wei（2026）的方法，我们以技能使用作为条件：在运行中使用了B智能体但未使用A智能体的损失属于替代效应；仅使用A智能体的损失属于干扰效应；而未使用任何技能的运行则构成第三组。

sents.en: As control checks, A A alone should mostly fulfill its core functions and B B alone should mostly not, and we report the loss separately on the exclusive and the shared core functions (§ 3.6 ).
sents.zh: 作为控制检查，单独使用A智能体应主要实现其核心功能，而单独使用B智能体则不应主要实现这些功能；我们将分别报告在专属核心功能和共享核心功能上的损失（§3.6）。

sents.en: Sensitivity analyses use the first primary core function only, all applicable core functions, and only the core functions whose script does not pass on the starting repository.
sents.zh: 敏感性分析仅使用第一个主要核心功能、所有适用核心功能，以及仅那些脚本在初始仓库中未通过验证的核心功能。

paragraphs.en: For RQ3 (challenge ❸), the first read of a skill in a run with A A and B B co-installed is the first tool call that invokes it through the Skill tool or reads or runs a file in its directory. When the runs of a pair–model combination in the A+B and the swapped configuration open different skills first, the combination compares opening B B first with opening A A first within the pair. We average over the two directions of this flip, which removes any effect of the configuration, and use a pair-level bootstrap with a Holm correction over three measures and four groups (pooled and per model). The guard is a pre-tool hook that denies the first read of B B while A A is unread and tells the model to use A A , without naming any core function, and denies B B once A A is in use. A run reaches for a skill first when its first attempt to read a skill targets that skill, whether or not the hook denies it. The guard acts only when a run reaches for B B , so we rerun the 187 pair–model combinations (119 pairs) in which the model opened B B first in the main experiment, each once with and once without the hook in random order. The 148 combinations whose outcome scripts decide run a second time. All 670 runs use the image, models, and settings of the main experiment. We compare the two configurations on the fidelity of A A , judged as in the main experiment, over all runs and over the runs that reach for B B first in both configurations, and read compliance from the log of the hook.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题3（挑战❸），在同时安装了A A和B B的运行中，首次读取某个技能是指首次通过技能工具调用该技能，或读取/运行其目录中的文件。 当A+B配置与交换后的配置中，某对模型组合的运行首次打开的技能不同时，该组合会在该对内部比较先打开B B与先打开A A的情况。 我们对这种翻转的两种方向取平均值，从而消除配置的任何影响，并使用对三级测量和四组数据（合并及按模型分别计算）进行Holm校正的成对层级自助法。 该守卫是一个工具前钩子：在A A尚未被读取时，它会阻止对B B的首次读取，并指示模型使用A A，且不提及任何核心函数；一旦A A开始使用，它便会阻止B B。 当运行的首次技能读取尝试针对某个技能时，无论该钩子是否阻止了它，该运行都视为首先尝试获取该技能。 守卫仅在运行尝试获取B B时才会生效，因此我们对主实验中模型首次打开B B的187个模型-组合（119对）进行了重新运行：每个组合分别在有钩子和无钩子的情况下各运行一次，顺序随机。 结果脚本决定需要二次运行的148个组合将再次运行。 全部670次运行均使用主实验中的图像、模型和设置。 我们在所有运行中，以及在两种配置下都首先尝试获取B B的运行中，比较两种配置在A A保真度上的差异（判断方式与主实验相同），并从钩子的日志中读取合规性信息。

paragraphs.en: LLMs assisted repository typing (§ 3.2 ), pair confirmation (§ 3.4 ), skill labeling (§ 3.5 ), core-function extraction and labeling (§ 3.6 ), runnability judgments and case drafting (§ 3.7 ), and output judging (§ 3.9 ), and every step was checked and guided by humans as described next.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型辅助了仓库类型判定（§ 3.2）、配对确认（§ 3.4）、技能标注（§ 3.5）、核心功能提取与标注（§ 3.6）、可运行性判断与案例起草（§ 3.7）以及输出评判（§ 3.9），并且如后文所述，每一步都由人类进行检查和引导。

paragraphs.en: Because LLM annotators and judges reach agreement close to that between humans on some tasks ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) but not on others ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ; Zhuge et al., 2025 ) , two human raters validate every LLM-assisted step on a random sample. For each step, both raters label the same sample independently and without seeing the labels of the LLM, and they resolve disagreements by discussion ( Ralph et al., 2021 ) . All labeling, by the LLM and by the raters, is done without access to any run, except the output verdicts and their check, whose items are runs. Samples have 100 items for repository types, pair verdicts, skill types, and output verdicts, a size that related fields commonly use ( Baltes et al., 2026 ) , drawn at random or, for the output judge, stratified by verdict, and 30 skills for offline runnability, 30 cases for applicability, and 30 pairs for core functions. We report Krippendorff’s α \alpha , read against the thresholds of 0.8 for firm and 0.667 for tentative conclusions ( Baltes et al., 2026 ) . Between the raters and between their consensus and the LLM, α \alpha is 0.84 and 0.80 for repository types, 0.76 and 0.72 for the pair judge, and 0.74 and 0.71 for skill types. For the output judge, it is 0.83 and 0.78 on core functions, 0.80 and 0.75 on task completion, and 0.88 and 0.84 on disclosure. For offline runnability, it is 0.81 and 0.77, and for whether each core function applies to the request of a case, it is 0.85 and 0.81. For core functions, it is 0.77 and 0.73 on which requirements of a skill are core functions, and 0.79 and 0.74 on the exclusive-or-shared label.
paragraphs.zh: 由于在某些任务上，大型语言模型（LLM）标注员和评判员的共识接近人类之间的共识（Ahmed et al., 2025; Zheng et al., 2023），但在其他任务上则不然（Ahmed et al., 2025; Zhuge et al., 2025），因此两名人类评分员会对每个由 LLM 辅助的步骤在随机样本上进行验证。 对于每个步骤，两名评分员都会独立地对同一样本进行标注，且不会查看 LLM 的标签；他们通过讨论解决分歧（Ralph et al., 2021）。 LLM 和评分员的所有标注工作均在不访问任何运行实例的情况下完成，仅能获取输出判定结果及其检查项，而这些项目本身即属于运行实例。 样本包含 100 个条目，分别用于仓库类型、成对判定、技能类型和输出判定，这一规模在相关领域中被广泛采用（Baltes et al., 2026）；这些条目通过随机抽样获取，而对于输出评判员，则按判定结果进行分层抽样。此外，样本还包含 30 项技能用于离线运行性评估、30 个案例用于适用性评估，以及 30 对用于核心功能评估。 我们报告了 Krippendorff’s α \alpha 值，并以 0.8（代表明确结论）和 0.667（代表初步结论）作为判断阈值（Baltes et al., 2026）。 在仓库类型方面，评分员之间的 α \alpha 值为 0.84，而评分员共识与 LLM 之间的 α \alpha 值为 0.80；在成对判定方面，该值分别为 0.76 和 0.72；在技能类型方面，该值分别为 0.74 和 0.71。 对于输出评判员，核心功能的 α \alpha 值为 0.83 和 0.78，任务完成的 α \alpha 值为 0.80 和 0.75，披露信息的 α \alpha 值为 0.88 和 0.84。 离线运行性的 α \alpha 值为 0.81 和 0.77；而某项核心功能是否适用于某个案例的请求，其 α \alpha 值为 0.85 和 0.81。 在核心功能方面，关于某项技能的具体要求中哪些属于核心功能，α \alpha 值为 0.77 和 0.73；关于“排他或共享”标签的标注，α \alpha 值为 0.79 和 0.74。

paragraphs.en: Skills that do the same job are common (challenge ❸, § 3.5 ). For an estimated 63.7% of installed skills (95% CI [61.3%, 66.0%]), or about 26,100 families, the most similar skill by another author does the same job, and for 23.5% (95% CI [21.2%, 25.7%]), or about 10,100 families, the most similar skill in the same installation list does, both conservative because the pair judge sees only the most similar candidate. Copied collections bring many of these pairs. In the 489 projects that copy a whole collection, with up to 1,382 skills, 37% of the judged skills have a skill that does the same job in the same list, against 19% in other lists. Overall, in 69% of the confirmed within-project pairs at least one skill also exists outside the project, in a collection, a plugin, or another repository, and in the other 31% both skills exist only in that project. Weighted to the frame, the installed skill is normative in 60% of the confirmed cross-project pairs and 56% of the within-project ones, a capability skill in 31% and 35%, and script-bearing in about 9%.
paragraphs.zh: 执行相同任务的技能很常见（挑战 ❸，§ 3.5）。 在已安装技能的约 63.7%（95% CI [61.3%, 66.0%]），即大约 26,100 个家庭中，另一位作者提出的最相似技能能执行相同任务；而在 23.5%（95% CI [21.2%, 25.7%]），即大约 10,100 个家庭中，同一安装列表中最相似的技能也能执行该任务。这两个比例都较为保守，因为成对评估者仅能看到最相似的候选技能。 复制的集合带来了许多这样的成对组合。 在 489 个完整复制整个集合的项目中（最多包含 1,382 项技能），经评估的技能中有 37% 在相同列表内存在能执行相同任务的技能，而在其他列表中这一比例为 19%。 总体而言，在已确认的项目内部成对组合中，有 69% 至少有一项技能也存在于项目之外（如某个集合、插件或其他仓库）；而在其余 31% 的组合中，两项技能仅存在于该项目内。 根据框架进行加权后，在已确认的跨项目成对组合中，已安装技能具有规范性特征的比例为 60%，项目内部成对组合中则为 56%；具备能力型特征的比例分别为 31% 和 35%，而包含脚本的特征比例约为 9%。

paragraphs.en: RQ1 asks whether and why co-installing B B lowers task completion and the fidelity of A A , which we answer by comparing the A+B configuration with the only- A A configuration pair by pair (§ 3.9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1（RQ1）旨在探究联合安装 B B 是否会导致任务完成度和 A A 的保真度下降，以及其背后的原因。我们通过逐对比较 A+B 配置与仅使用 A A 的配置来回答这一问题（§ 3.9）。

paragraphs.en: The fidelity measure separates the two skills, whereas task completion does not (gray bands in Figure 4 a). With only A A installed, 57.3% of its primary core functions are fulfilled, and with only B B installed, 46.3% (11.0 percentage points, pp, lower, 95% CI [ − 13.5 -13.5 , − 8.6 -8.6 ]), at equal task completion (57.2% and 58.1%). The split into exclusive and shared core functions separates them further, as B B alone fulfills 16.1 pp fewer of the exclusive ones than A A alone, against 5.5 pp fewer of the shared ones (§ 3.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 保真度指标区分了这两种能力，而任务完成度则没有（图4a中的灰色区域）。 仅安装A A时，其57.3%的核心主要功能得以实现；仅安装B B时，这一比例为46.3%（低11.0个百分点，pp，95%置信区间[−13.5至−13.5，−8.6至−8.6]），而任务完成度则相当（分别为57.2%和58.1%）。 将核心功能划分为专属功能和共享功能进一步区分了二者：仅使用B B时，其实现的专属功能比仅使用A A时少16.1个百分点，而共享功能则少5.5个百分点（§3.6）。

paragraphs.en: A similar skill takes runs away from the installed skill without failing the task, so the conflict hides behind success (challenge ❶, Figure 4 ). Co-installing B B lowers the share of runs that use A A by 19.9 pp (95% CI [ − 23.1 -23.1 , − 16.7 -16.7 ]), with every model (Figure 4 c). Task completion does not drop ( + 1.9 +1.9 pp, 95% CI [ − 1.0 -1.0 , + 4.9 +4.9 ]), whereas the fidelity of A A falls by 2.6 pp ([ − 4.4 -4.4 , − 0.8 -0.8 ]), a quarter of the 11.0 pp that separate B B alone from A A alone (Figure 4 a), with a lower point estimate for every model. The loss concentrates on what only A A provides. On the core functions exclusive to A A , fidelity falls by 5.6 pp (95% CI [ − 7.3 -7.3 , − 3.8 -3.8 ]), significantly with every model, whereas on the shared ones it does not change ( + 0.1 +0.1 pp, [ − 2.8 -2.8 , + 2.9 +2.9 ]). A check of task completion therefore sees no harm, whereas the core functions that only A A provides are lost.
paragraphs.zh: 一项类似技能能够在不失败的情况下取代已安装的智能体，因此这种冲突隐藏在成功背后（挑战 ❶，图 4）。 同时安装 B B 会使使用 A A 的运行比例下降 19.9 个百分点（95% CI [ − 23.1 -23.1 , − 16.7 -16.7 ]），且所有模型均如此（图 4 c）。 任务完成率并未下降（+1.9 个百分点，95% CI [ − 1.0 -1.0 , + 4.9 +4.9 ]），但 A A 的保真度下降了 2.6 个百分点（[ − 4.4 -4.4 , − 0.8 -0.8 ]），这仅占单独使用 B B 与单独使用 A A 之间 11.0 个百分点差异的四分之一（图 4 a），且所有模型的点估计值均更低。 这种损失主要集中在只有 A A 才能提供的功能上。 在 A A 独有的核心功能上，保真度下降了 5.6 个百分点（95% CI [ − 7.3 -7.3 , − 3.8 -3.8 ]），且所有模型均表现出显著下降；而在共享功能上则没有变化（+0.1 个百分点，[ − 2.8 -2.8 , + 2.9 +2.9 ]）。 因此，对任务完成率的检查并未发现任何损害，但只有 A A 提供的核心功能却出现了损失。

paragraphs.en: Most of the loss occurs in runs that do not use A A at all (Figure 4 b). With B B co-installed, 12.1% of runs use only B B and 38.0% use neither skill, against 30.3% that do not use A A in the only- A A configuration (Figure 5 ). A substituted run loses 8.0 pp of fidelity against the only- A A run, the deepest bar in Figure 4 b. Substituted runs carry 36% of the fidelity loss and runs that use neither skill 45%, whereas runs that use A A , where interference would show, carry only 20%. With C C , 36.0% of runs use neither skill and 0.1% use only C C , so beyond one more skill, B B adds mainly substitution.
paragraphs.zh: 大部分损失出现在完全未使用 A A 的运行中（图 4b）。 在同时安装 B B 的情况下，12.1% 的运行仅使用 B B，38.0% 的运行未使用任何技能，而在仅使用 A A 的配置中，未使用 A A 的运行比例为 30.3%（图 5）。 替换运行与仅使用 A A 的运行相比，保真度下降了 8.0 个百分点，这在图 4b 中最深的柱状图中可见。 替换运行造成了 36% 的保真度损失，而未使用任何技能的运行则造成了 45% 的损失；相比之下，在可能出现干扰的情况下，使用 A A 的运行仅造成了 20% 的损失。 在使用 C C 时，36.0% 的运行未使用任何技能，0.1% 的运行仅使用 C C；因此，在增加一项技能后，B B 主要起到替换作用。

paragraphs.en: RQ2 asks how the choice between the two skills, made out of sight (challenge ❷), depends on listing order, scope, and the model, and whether the user is told.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2旨在探讨，在幕后（挑战❷）对两种技能的选择如何依赖于列表顺序、范围以及模型，以及用户是否被告知这一选择。

paragraphs.en: Listing order barely affects which skill is used (Figure 5 ). The swapped configuration reverses the order by renaming B B with a one-character prefix, so we separate the two effects by contrasting the pairs that listed A A first with the others. Order changes the use of A A by only + 0.6 +0.6 pp (95% CI [ − 2.0 -2.0 , + 3.3 +3.3 ]), whereas renaming B B adds + 4.4 +4.4 pp, in contrast to the position bias reported for selection among functionally equivalent tools ( Blankenstein et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 列表顺序几乎不影响所用技能（图5）。 通过为 B B 添加一个单字符前缀来重命名，可反转交换后的配置顺序；因此，我们通过对比将 A A 列为首位的组与其他组，来区分这两种影响。 顺序变化对 A A 使用率的影响仅为 +0.6 +0.6 pp（95% CI [−2.0 -2.0, +3.3 +3.3]），而重命名 B B 则增加了 +4.4 +4.4 pp，这与功能等效工具选择中报告的位置偏差（Blankenstein et al., 2026）形成对比。

paragraphs.en: For skills of the same name, scope decides which skill is used (lower group of Figure 5 ). With B B in the personal directory, A A appears in none of the 243 listings, as the listing rules predict, and the share of runs that use A A drops by 35.0 pp ([ − 43.0 -43.0 , − 26.9 -26.9 ]). The model uses B B in 46.5% of these runs, as in the second run of Figure 3 , yet in 29.2% it still reads the files of A A from the project directory, and the fidelity of A A is 3.9 pp below the only- A A configuration (95% CI [ − 7.5 -7.5 , − 0.3 -0.3 ]). With B B in a plugin, the model uses A A in 58.0% of runs and B B in only 2.9%, and the use of A A drops by 6.2 pp, against 16.9 pp when the same pairs have B B in the project.

paragraphs.en: RQ3 asks at what point in a run a conflict is decided and whether a guard at that point keeps the core functions of A A (challenge ❸).
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 探讨的是在执行过程中冲突是在哪个时刻被决定的，以及该时刻的守卫是否维持了 A A 的核心功能（挑战 ❸）。

paragraphs.en: A conflict is decided at the first read of a skill (Figure 6 ). In 79 pair–model combinations (63 pairs), the A+B and the swapped configuration, which differ only in the listing order and a one-character prefix on B B , open different skills first, and up to that read their runs look alike (median 6 against 6 tool calls). There, the run that opens B B first fulfills 9.4 pp fewer exclusive core functions of A A (95% CI [ − 15.0 -15.0 , − 4.0 -4.0 ], Holm-adjusted p = 0.004 p=0.004 ) and 7.5 pp fewer applicable ones ([ − 12.6 -12.6 , − 2.6 -2.6 ]). It is 22.1 pp with Haiku 4.5, 12.1 pp with Sonnet 4.6, not significant after correction, and none with Opus 5, which often reads both skills (Figure 6 b). The first read comes before the work, as 97% of the runs that open B B first change no file before they open it, and files start to change only after the first read (Figure 6 a).
paragraphs.zh: 冲突在首次读取技能时即被决定（图 6）。 在 79 种模型–配对组合中（63 对），A+B 配置与交换后的配置仅以列表顺序和 B B 上的一个字符前缀不同，但两者首先开启的技能不同，且直到那次读取为止，它们的运行过程看起来相似（中位数均为 6 次工具调用）。 在这些情况下，首先开启 B B 的运行比 A A 少完成了 9.4 pp 的专属核心功能（95% CI [−15.0 -15.0, −4.0 -4.0]，Holm 校正后 p = 0.004），以及 7.5 pp 的可适用功能（[−12.6 -12.6, −2.6 -2.6]）。 使用 Haiku 4.5 时差异为 22.1 pp，使用 Sonnet 4.6 时为 12.1 pp，校正后不再显著；而使用 Opus 5 时则无差异，因为该模型通常会同时读取两种技能（图 6b）。 首次读取发生在实际工作之前，因为 97% 首先开启 B B 的运行在打开它之前没有修改任何文件，而文件的修改仅在首次读取之后才开始（图 6a）。

paragraphs.en: The guard keeps the core functions of A A (Figure 6 c). When the hook denied a first reach for B B , the model switched to A A in 96% of the 179 cases (Sonnet 4.6 94%, Haiku 4.5 96%, Opus 5 99%). Runs redirected by the hook did not differ from runs without the hook that opened A A first ( 0.0 0.0 pp, [ − 10.2 -10.2 , + 10.3 +10.3 ]), so the hook recovered all of the 16.5 pp that opening B B first costs without it, and task completion did not change ( + 4.1 +4.1 pp, [ − 1.3 -1.3 , + 9.6 +9.6 ]). paragraphs.en: A conflict hides behind success (challenge ❶), so skill evaluations should report what a skill uniquely contributes as well as whether the task is completed. A benchmark that scores task completion alone would have rated co-installation as harmless in our runs, although the use of the installed skill fell by 19.9 percentage points and its fidelity by 5.6 points on its exclusive core functions (§ 4.2 ). Core functions add little cost to a benchmark, because they are extracted once per skill, checked by scripts where possible, and frozen before any run, and benchmarks that already check the requirements of a skill ( Han et al., 2026a ; Shaposhnikov et al., 2026 ) could co-install a similar skill with the one under test.
paragraphs.zh: 成功背后隐藏着冲突（挑战 ❶），因此技能评估应报告某项技能的独特贡献，以及任务是否完成。 仅根据任务完成情况评分的基准测试，在我们的运行中会将联合安装评为无害，尽管已安装技能的使用率下降了 19.9 个百分点，其核心功能的保真度也下降了 5.6 个百分点（§ 4.2）。 核心功能对基准测试几乎不增加成本，因为每个技能只需提取一次，在可能的情况下由脚本进行检查，并在任何运行前固定下来；而已经检查技能要求的基准测试（Han et al., 2026a; Shaposhnikov et al., 2026）也可以将类似技能与正在测试的技能一起安装。

paragraphs.en: A conflict is resolved out of sight (challenge ❷), but platforms can make substitution visible. They can warn at session start when a personal skill overrides a project skill of the same name, as the issue report proposes ( seasonedcc/seasoned-skills, 2026 ) , and state which copy and scope a running skill came from. Platforms can also act at the first read of a skill, where a conflict is decided (challenge ❸, § 4.4 ). There, a pre-tool hook can point the model to the installed skill, as our guard does, and the platform can pin the answer once per pair, as a lockfile does. The final reply rarely fills this gap today (§ 4.3 ), and showing which skill ran would also expose the runs that use neither skill, whose share rises from 30.3% to 38.0% with a similar skill.
paragraphs.zh: 冲突是在幕后解决的（挑战 ❷），但平台可以让这种替换变得可见。 正如问题报告所提议的（seasonedcc/seasoned-skills，2026），它们可以在会话开始时提醒用户：当个人技能覆盖了同名的项目技能时，并说明当前运行的技能来自哪个版本和范围。 平台也可以在首次读取技能时采取行动，此时冲突将被决定（挑战 ❸，§ 4.4）。 在此过程中，一个预工具钩子可以将模型引导至已安装的技能，就像我们的防护机制所做的那样；同时平台也可以为每对输入锁定一次答案，就像锁文件所做的那样。 目前，最终回复很少能填补这一空白（§ 4.3），而显示具体运行了哪个技能，也能揭示那些未使用任何技能的运行实例——当引入一个类似的技能后，这类实例的比例会从 30.3% 上升到 38.0%。

paragraphs.en: Authors control the choice mainly through the name and description, the only text the model sees when choosing. A distinctive name avoids overrides by the platform, and a description that states the specific tasks of the skill reduces the chance that a request meant for another skill is routed to it. Users with skills from several sources can audit their personal directory for overriding skills, and projects that copy a whole collection can remove the skills that duplicate ones they already install, since copied collections bring many pairs that can conflict (§ 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 作者主要通过名称和描述来控制选择，因为这是模型在选择时唯一能看到的文本。 独特的名称可以避免被平台覆盖，而明确说明技能具体任务的描述则能降低本应分配给其他技能的请求被错误路由到该技能的可能性。 使用多个来源技能的用户可以检查其个人目录中是否存在覆盖性技能；而复制整个集合的项目则可以移除那些与已安装技能重复的技能，因为复制的集合会带来许多可能产生冲突的技能对（§ 4.1）。

paragraphs.en: We run the full design on Claude Code, the largest target of public skills, because it costs about $5,550 on one platform. Cross-project pairs are constructed, but within-project pairs, which projects actually co-install, show the same drop, as the use of A A falls by 18.3 percentage points (§ 4.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Empirical studies of skills have so far examined skills one at a time. Liu et al. (2026b) analyze 31,132 marketplace skills for security vulnerabilities, and Zhang et al. (2026) study the defects that keep skills from being reusable in 138,133 SKILL.md files. Closer to our setting, several studies show that more skills can mean worse results. Agents often fail to load the needed skills once they must search for them ( Liu et al., 2026c ) , and most of the pass-rate drop in larger libraries comes from wrong or missing skill selection ( Song and Wei, 2026 ) . All of these benchmark studies score a run by whether its task passes or by retrieval accuracy. A few recent benchmarks check the requirements written in a skill, such as its procedure, its forbidden operations, or its logical relations ( Han et al., 2026a ; Shaposhnikov et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , but none installs two skills that do the same job, so none can see one skill take over from the other. Closest to our question, SkillCoach argues that verifier success can mask runs that pick overlapping distractor skills ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , Saha et al. (2026) find that agents prefer an adversarially described copy of a skill, and Wang et al. (2026) examine the security risk of co-installed skills. We instead start from skills installed in public projects, pair each with a real, benign skill that does the same job, and measure what the conflict does to the core functions of the installed skill and whether the user is told.
paragraphs.zh: 迄今为止，关于技能的经验性研究一直是逐一考察各项技能。Liu 等人（2026b）分析了 31,132 项市场技能中的安全漏洞，而 Zhang 等人（2026）则研究了 138,133 个 SKILL.md 文件中导致技能无法重复使用的缺陷。更贴近我们研究场景的是，多项研究表明，技能数量越多，结果可能反而越差。一旦需要自行搜索所需技能，智能体常常无法成功加载（Liu 等人，2026c）；而在大型技能库中，通过率的大部分下降都源于错误或缺失的技能选择（Song 和 Wei，2026）。所有这些基准研究都是根据任务是否通过或检索准确性来评估一次运行的结果。近期的一些基准测试会检查技能中编写的需求，例如其流程、禁止操作或逻辑关系（Han 等人，2026a；Shaposhnikov 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2026a），但没有一项测试同时安装两个执行相同功能的技能，因此无法观察到其中一个技能如何接替另一个。最接近我们研究问题的是 SkillCoach：该研究认为，验证器的成功可能会掩盖那些选择了重叠的干扰性技能的运行结果（Zhu 等人，2026）；Saha 等人（2026）发现，智能体更倾向于选择以对抗性方式描述的技能副本；而 Wang 等人（2026）则考察了同时安装多个技能所带来的安全风险。与此不同，我们从公开项目中已安装的技能出发，将每个技能与一个执行相同功能的真实、无害的技能进行配对，并测量这种冲突对已安装技能核心功能的影响，以及用户是否被明确告知这一情况。

paragraphs.en: MetaTool evaluates whether models decide to use tools and pick the right one, including among similar choices ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . BiasBusters builds groups of functionally equivalent tools and finds that models fixate on one provider or favor tools that appear earlier ( Blankenstein et al., 2026 ) , and Faghih et al. (2025) show that edited descriptions can make a tool receive more than ten times as much usage. These studies report which tool is selected, whereas a skill injects instructions that change how the whole task is done, so selecting the similar skill can change the result.
paragraphs.zh: MetaTool 评估模型是否决定使用工具以及能否从中选择正确的工具，包括在相似选项中进行选择（Huang 等，2024）。 BiasBusters 构建了一组功能等效的工具，并发现模型会固守某一提供商或偏好较早出现的工具（Blankenstein 等，2026），而 Faghih 等 （2025）的研究表明，经过编辑的描述可以使某项工具的使用频率提升十倍以上。 这些研究报告了所选用的工具，而一项技能则会注入指令，改变整个任务的执行方式，因此选择相似的技能可能会改变最终结果。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering has long studied components that work alone but fail together. Feature-interaction research examines features whose combination behaves unexpectedly ( Calder et al., 2003 ; Apel et al., 2013 ) , and studies of package distributions analyze conflicts between packages ( Artho et al., 2012 ; Vouillon and Di Cosmo, 2013 ) and between dependency versions ( Wang et al., 2020 ) . Decca grades dependency conflicts by whether the loaded version covers the features that a project uses ( Wang et al., 2018 ) , much as exclusive core functions do for skills. Skills add a new kind of interaction, because the model decides which component runs based on natural-language descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程长期以来一直在研究那些单独工作时正常、但组合在一起却会出故障的组件。 特征交互研究关注那些组合后表现异常的特征（Calder 等，2003；Apel 等，2013），而软件包分发研究则分析软件包之间的冲突（Artho 等，2012；Vouillon 和 Di Cosmo，2013）以及依赖版本之间的冲突（Wang 等，2020）。 Decca 根据已加载的版本是否覆盖了项目所使用的特征来对依赖冲突进行分级（Wang 等，2018），这与排他性核心功能对技能的处理方式类似。 技能引入了一种新的交互类型，因为模型会根据自然语言描述来决定运行哪个组件。

paragraphs.en: A similar skill takes one in five runs away from the installed skill and lowers its fidelity, above all on its exclusive core functions, while task completion stays flat. Where a skill is installed decides which one runs, the final reply rarely says so, and the conflict is decided at the first read of a skill, where a pre-tool hook keeps the core functions of the installed skill. Because other agents that read the Agent Skills format, such as Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot, also choose skills from names and descriptions, skill evaluations should measure what a skill uniquely contributes, and platforms should guard the first read and show which skill ran.
paragraphs.zh: 类似的一项技能会在五次运行中有一次偏离已安装的技能，并降低其保真度，尤其体现在其专属核心功能上，而任务完成度则保持不变。 已安装的技能决定了哪项技能会被运行，但最终回复很少说明这一点；冲突在首次读取技能时即被决定，此时一个预工具钩子会保留已安装技能的核心功能。 由于其他读取“智能体技能”格式的智能体（如 Codex、Gemini CLI 和 GitHub Copilot）也会根据名称和描述选择技能，因此技能评估应衡量某项技能的独特贡献，平台也应保护首次读取过程并显示实际运行的是哪项技能。
